subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate idiom for the given situation.**

Shayam was accused of bribery, but he submitted proofs for his innocence.

options.text: Buying the pig in a poke

solution:
The correct answer is **"Chapter and verse."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Chapter and verse"** means to provide detailed and specific evidence or information to support a claim or argument. (किसी दावे या तर्क का समर्थन करने के लिए विस्तृत और विशिष्ट साक्ष्य या जानकारी प्रदान करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *She came home and gave me **chapter and verse**__ about going to his place after a drink.*
 
 
 
• In this situation, Shyam provided proof to support his claim of innocence.
 
• This idiom comes from the practice of citing specific chapters and verses in religious texts to support an argument.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Buying the pig in a poke" **means to buy something without inspecting it first. (किसी चीज़ का पहले निरीक्षण किए बिना उसे खरीदना)
 
• **"Cast pearls before swine" **means to offer something valuable to someone who doesn't appreciate it. (किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति को कोई मूल्यवान वस्तु प्रदान करना जो उसकी सराहना नहीं करता)
 
• **"Beating about the bush"** means to avoid getting to the point or being indirect in conversation. (मुद्दे पर पहुंचने या बातचीत में अप्रत्यक्ष होने से बचना)
